verdict.rationale: cubic documents auto-approval of PRs that meet your review policy and are judged low risk and issue-free, plus auto-resolution of finding threads once fixed. Combined with GitHub branch protection, these could indirectly act as a merge gate, but the evidence never describes a required status check or a blocking/request-changes review that stops merges until critical findings are resolved. Missing for 10: a documented required status check or blocking review on critical findings, severity-based merge-blocking configuration, branch-protection integration docs, and independent corroboration.
